svg.title: Expanding center 2, the character s[1]
svg.desc: abacca. l and r start together on s[1] (violet); then l is blue, r amber, the confirmed palindrome green. start l=r=1: widen. step 1 l=0 r=2: a == a, widen. step 2 l=-1 r=3: l out of bounds, stop. Widest palindrome s[0..2] = aba.
svg.text: odd case: center 2, the character s[1]
